issues.title: Ingest Van Buren County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $17,527,559 across 25 funds. The largest: County General ($6,950,107), County Road ($4,566,598), VFD/Res-Q Sales Tax ($1,700,000). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
